title: The Great Hall

location.name: The Orc Great Hall
location.description: A pillared dwarven hall the orcs have fouled into a warren — cook-fires, bone piles, and hide bedding between soot-stained columns. Trophy skulls hang from the pillars. A raised dais at the far end holds the warband's chief.

read_aloud: Beyond the gatehouse the passage opens into a great pillared hall, thick with smoke and the reek of unwashed bodies. Cook-fires gutter between soot-blackened columns; gnawed bones litter the floor. On a raised dais at the far end squats a hulking brute a head taller than the rest — Great Ulfe, the orc chief — flanked by snarling war dogs. A dozen eyes turn toward you at once.

enemies.special: Great Ulfe — warband chief. While he lives, orcs use Aggressive to close every turn. If he falls, surviving orcs must make a morale check (DC 12 WIS) or flee.
Use pillars for cover; charge with Aggressive.

enemies.position: chained near the dais, released turn 1

encounters.tactics: Ulfe charges the sturdiest-looking PC. Orcs use pillars for cover and flank; war dogs harry spellcasters and archers. The cook-fires can be kicked/exploded (see interactables). If the ch1-act-I alarm was raised, add 2 orcs.
encounters.description: The warband's heart. Winning here clears the upper level and opens the stair down to the Glitterhame.

loot.location: Great Ulfe's trophy chest behind the dais
looted gear in the bone piles, Investigation DC 12
Great Ulfe wears them — he uses them (STR 19 already reflected). A prize for a martial PC.

skill_checks.success: After Ulfe falls, cow the survivors into fleeing without further fighting.
skill_checks.context: Breaking orc morale once the chief is down.

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): orcs 6 (from ~4), war dogs 3, Ulfe as boss. This is the level-1 climax. 3+ interactables: cook-fires (kick into a square — DEX save DC12 or 1d6 fire + prone), loose pillars (Athletics to topple onto a line), the chained war dogs (can be kept chained with a lock/hold). A stone stair behind the dais descends to the Glitterhame (Chapter 2).
